title: Seventy years of the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh
author: Editorial Desk
summary: A year-long celebration that BMS called a time to look back and introspect.
body:
*Photo: BMS seventieth anniversary celebration, July 2025*

On **23 July 2025** the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh completed seventy years. Its year-long celebration, which began in July 2024, was described on the BMS website as more than a ritual: a moment to look back, to ask how BMS began, what it has achieved and what remains to be done.

## What seventy years add up to

- **A national centre:** BMS describes itself as India's largest central trade union organisation, with a stated membership of about four crore.
- **Federations in many sectors:** from railways, defence, banks and insurance to construction, mines, plantations and scheme workers.
- **A distinct philosophy:** *Rashtra hit, Udyog hit, Mazdoor hit*, and the slogan *Workers unite the world.*
- **A voice at international forums:** the ILO and the BRICS Trade Union Forum.

## Looking ahead

Anniversaries invite two questions. What was learnt, and what is next? For BMS, the next frontiers are the unorganised sector, platform and gig workers, scheme workers, and the effect of new technology on jobs.

## An old principle

Dattopant Thengadi used to say that an organisation grows by the quality of its karyakartas. That is the best measure of the seventy years, and of the next seventy.
